about.metaDescription: Mind.com is the company behind InterMIND — technology for borderless conversation. EU intellectual-property holder (MindMeeting OÜ, Estonia) and UAE operational entity (Golden Fish CSP LLC, Dubai).
about.lede: Mind.com is the company behind InterMIND — technology for borderless conversation.
about.whoBody: Mind.com is a technology company building InterMIND: real-time multilingual communication that lets people work together across languages without losing meaning. This site is the company's front door — for partners, press, and anyone verifying who stands behind the product.
about.buildBody1: InterMIND lets everyone in a meeting speak and be understood in their own language, in real time. Instead of defaulting to a shared second-best language, each person keeps their own — and tone, nuance, and intent come through intact.
about.structureLead: Mind.com operates through two legal entities — intellectual property held in the EU, operations run from the UAE:
about.entityEuRole: EU entity — holds the intellectual property.
about.approach1: Verifiable over trust-us. Quality you can check against a public standard — not marketing claims.
about.approach2: Language shouldn't decide who you can work with. Borders and accents are not a filter on talent or opportunity.
about.approach3: Small team, AI-amplified. People lead the decisions; AI does the heavy lifting.

brand.metaDescription: Download the Mind.com logo, mark, app icon, favicon and social assets. Official brand files in SVG and PNG, plus color and usage guidance.
brand.lede: Everything you need to represent Mind.com correctly — the mark in every format, our color, and a few simple rules. Download and use as-is.
brand.usageDo1: Keep clear space around the mark equal to at least half its height.
brand.usageDo2: Use the white mark on dark or busy backgrounds, the gradient mark on light ones.
brand.usageDont1: Don't recolor, rotate, stretch, or add effects to the mark.
brand.usageDont2: Don't place the mark on low-contrast backgrounds where it's hard to read.

assets.markDesc: The primary Mind.com mark — grey gradient on a transparent background.
assets.markWhiteDesc: Solid white version for dark backgrounds.
assets.avatarDesc: 512×512 square mark for profile pictures and avatars.
assets.appIconDesc: 1024×1024 rounded square on the brand dark plate — for iOS and Android.
assets.faviconDesc: Small-size marks optimized for browser tabs, from 16 to 256 px.
assets.socialDesc: 1500×500 banner with the mark centered on the brand dark background.
